Mohammad Kaif warns players about guaranteed team spots

Former cricketer Mohammad Kaif has issued a warning to players, including Tilak Varma, stating that being a vice-captain does not guarantee a place in the playing XI. He cited the example of Axar Patel to emphasize that performance is key to retaining a spot in the team.
